Residential canal polygons are colored by mean distance. Orange points are FDEP Impaired Waters Rule (IWR) Run 68 stations that fall inside a canal polygon. Click a station to see its period of record and a summary of each water quality parameter. Click a canal to see its attributes. Use the control in the top right to turn either layer on or off.

source('plot_rescanal_leaflet.R')
